Q.wikitext:
{{#vardefine:q_b1|20}}{{#vardefine:q_b5|60}}{{#vardefine:q_ap|42.5}}{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Poison Trail|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Singed |skill = Q |icon = Poison Trail.png |blurb = {{sbc|Toggle:}} {{ci|Singed}} continually creates a toxic cloud that shortly lingers in his wake, which continually inflicts {{tip|poison}} to enemies within. |blurb4 = {{sbc|{{tip|poison|nolink=true}}:}} The target continually takes {{as|magic damage}} over a short time. Subsequent inflictions refresh the duration. |description = {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Singed''' continually creates a toxic cloud in his wake that lingers for {{fd|3.25}} seconds. The cloud inflicts {{tip|poison}} to enemies within.

''Poison Trail'' is toggled off automatically if '''Singed''' becomes unable to pay its {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost. |description2 = {{sbc|{{tip|poison|nolink=true}}:}} The target takes {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over 2 seconds as well as upon being hit if not currently affected. Subsequent inflictions refresh the duration. |leveling2 = {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|{{#var:q_b1}}/4 to {{#var:q_b5}}/4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:q_ap}}/4}}% AP)}}|Magic Damage per Second|{{ap|{{#var:q_b1}} to {{#var:q_b5}}}} {{as|(+ {{fd|{{#var:q_ap}}}}% AP)}}|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|({{#var:q_b1}}/4)*8 to ({{#var:q_b5}}/4)*8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|({{#var:q_ap}}/4)*8}}% AP)}}}} |description3 = '''Singed''' earns the kill credit of enemy {{tip|minions}} that are {{tip|poison|poisoned}} and would die to the damage of allied minions within the time before the next damage instance. |effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|180|Individual gas clouds}} |cost = 13 |static = 1 |costtype = Mana per second |cast time = none |targeting = Auto |affects = Enemies |damagetype = Magic |spellshield = |spelleffects = AoEDoT |projectile = |grounded = |knockdown = |notes = * Toggled abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive. * When ''Poison Trail's'' debuff is applied instead of refreshed, the target is dealt one additional instance of the debuff at the same time as the application. This is done by delaying the actual debuff by {{fd|0.1}} seconds. ** If the target is already affected by the debuff, its duration is refreshed to the maximum (2 seconds). * While active after spawning, a cloud checks for valid targets who remain in or re-enter a cloud every {{fd|0.25}} seconds. ** Valid targets already afflicted with the poison will have their debuff's duration refreshed every {{fd|0.25}} seconds if applicable. * If '''Singed''' has moved fewer than 90 units since spawning the last poison cloud, it will spawn 35 units in front of him. They also only spawn every 1 second in this case. ** When '''Singed''' is moving faster than that, the poison clouds spawn more frequently and on top of himself. }}

|champion     = Singed
|skill        = E
|icon         = Fling.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Singed}} {{tip|airborne|flings}} the target enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} based on {{as|their '''maximum''' health}}.
|blurb2       = If the target lands on ''{{ai|Mega Adhesive|Singed}}'', they are briefly {{tip|root|rooted}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Singed''' {{tip|airborne|flings}} the target enemy 550 units over himself over {{rutngt|0.666}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}}. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at 300 against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}. 
|leveling     = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|50 to 90}} {{as|(+ {{ap|6 to 8}}% of target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}}}}
|description2 = If the target lands on ''{{ais|Mega Adhesive|Singed}}'' area of effect after the displacement, they are {{tip|root|rooted}} for a duration.

|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = True

|projectile   = 
|callforhelp  = true
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|notes        = 
* During ''Fling'' cast time (the windup not during the actual fling) the enemy's flash is already locked, making it a non reactable spell.
* ''Fling'' can throw enemies over walls (circumstances permitting).
* {{tip|Slow-immune}} enemies will not be {{tip|root|rooted}} when ''flung'' into {{ai|Mega Adhesive|Singed}}.
* ''Fling'' is special cased to not {{tip|airborne|fling}} {{ci|Warwick}} while '''Singed''' is {{tip|suppression|suppressed}} by {{ai|Infinite Duress|Warwick}} after the cast time.
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}
